_comment: Was a REF effect handed a 'target'. DESTROY_REF/BANISH_REF act on get_ref(ref), the handler does not read 'target', and no earlier effect in the ability sets a ref -- so it aimed at no object and returned. 'Destroy the top card of the deck' is a zone, and DECK_TOP is deliberately the top card only -- resolving it to the whole deck would turn it into a prompt to choose any card, a different effect and an information leak.
